title: Job Openings at Sweet Sensation
content:
Sweet Sensation is a proudly Nigerian Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) brand with over 30 years of excellence in serving delicious African and Continental meals. With outlets across Lagos and Ogun States, we’re known for quality, innovation, and exceptional customer service. At Sweet Sensation, we offer a supportive work environment, opportunities for career growth, continuous learning, and the chance to be part of a passionate team shaping Nigeria’s food service industry.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Operations & Kitchen Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview
     

            
    




	A growing Nigerian food business is seeking a competent, hands-on, and highly organised professional to join our team in Lagos.
	The successful candidate will oversee daily kitchen and production operations, supervise kitchen employees, manage inventory, coordinate supplies to multiple outlets, and ensure consistent food quality and safety.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate daily food preparation, production, packaging, and dispatch.
	Supervise kitchen employees and monitor productivity.
	Manage inventory, stock records, and production documentation.
	Coordinate product supplies and deliveries to outlets.
	Ensure compliance with hygiene, quality, and food safety standards.
	Support operational administration and business coordination.


Requirements


	Relevant experience in Nigerian food production, restaurants, catering, or central kitchens.
	Knowledge of amala, traditional soups, and meat preparation.
	Experience supervising kitchen or production teams.
	Strong organisational, communication, and record-keeping skills.
	Proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, and other basic digital tools.


Application Closing Date: 20th October, 2026.

Method of Applictaion
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their their updated CV to: [email protected] using “Application for Operations & Kitchen Manager” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

 

2.) Growth & Business Developement Manager

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	A growing Nigerian food business is seeking a commercially driven, results-oriented, and execution-focused professional to lead business growth and revenue development initiatives.
	The successful candidate will drive customer acquisition and retention, develop strategic partnerships, grow corporate and institutional sales, and convert commercial opportunities into measurable revenue.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and manage corporate, institutional, catering, event, and bulk-order sales pipelines.
	Drive customer acquisition, retention, reactivation, and loyalty initiatives.
	Develop strategic partnerships and commercial opportunities.
	Improve CRM utilisation and customer-data management.
	Support outlet growth and local market development.
	Drive sales conversion, upselling, and cross-selling initiatives.
	Monitor sales performance and maintain growth dashboards.


Requirements


	Relevant experience in business development, sales, commercial growth, or key account management.
	Proven ability to convert sales opportunities and build recurring customer relationships.
	Experience in food service, hospitality, retail, FMCG, or catering is desirable.
	Strong networking, negotiation, communication, and commercial skills.
	Ability to manage sales pipelines, CRM, and performance reports.
	Strong follow-through, initiative, and results orientation.


Application Closing Date: 20th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their their updated CV to: [email protected] using “Application for Growth & Business Development Manager” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

3.) Restaurant Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary 


	A reputable Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) with multiple outlets across Lagos is seeking experienced and passionate Restaurant Managers to join our growing team.
	The ideal candidates must be customer-focused, operationally sound, and capable of leading high-performing teams.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee daily restaurant operations across both front and back-of-house.
	Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality customer service and overall guest satisfaction.
	Implement customer loyalty, reward, and retention initiatives.
	Develop and execute restaurant-level promotional and marketing activities.
	Handle customer inquiries, feedback, and complaints promptly and professionally.
	Organize, schedule, and supervise staff shifts.
	Lead, coach, train, mentor, and evaluate restaurant team members.
	Manage inventory levels, forecast operational needs, and ensure uninterrupted supply of stock.
	Minimize product waste and maintain strict cost control measures.
	Ensure a clean, hygienic, safe, and positive working environment.
	Monitor day-to-day operations, identify service gaps, and implement corrective actions.
	Introduce innovative strategies to boost team productivity and drive sales growth.


Requirements & Qualifications


	B.Sc Degree or HND in a related field.
	Prior customer service experience.
	Previous experience as a Restaurant Manager or in a comparable supervisory food service role is an added advantage.
	Solid understanding of food preparation, hygiene standards, and dining room workflows.
	Strong leadership, motivational, and people management skills.
	Sound financial management, basic accounting, and reporting abilities.
	Strong analytical and numerical capabilities.
	Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.


Application Closing Date: 28th Sepetember, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their their resumes to: [email protected] using “Restaurant Manager” as the subject of the email.

Note


	Preference will be given to qualified candidates who reside in or around Yaba, Alagomeji, Gbagada, Iyana-Oworo, Ifako and Surulere.
	Proximity to these locations is a significant advantage due to operational requirements and ease of commute.

title: Job Openings at Velvot Nigeria Limited
content:
Velvot Nigeria Limited is aNigerian company specializing in modern digital transformation solutions powered by industry-leading Microsoft technologies. As a platform-neutral partner with top cloud providers, including Microsoft, Google, and Amazon, Velvot is committed to delivering tailored IT services and innovative cloud solutions.

We offer a comprehensive range of services, including expert cloud consultation, strategic IT services, seamless cloud migration, custom application development, managed services, and user adoption training. Our goal is to empower businesses to optimize their operations and stay ahead in an increasingly digital world.
     

            
    



By leveraging our expertise and strong partnerships, Velvot ensures that our clients receive the highest level of service and support, enabling them to thrive in the cloud and beyond.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Junior Accountant

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Finance Manager / CFO

Job Overview


	We are looking for a detail-oriented Accountant with at least 3 years of experience to join our finance team. In this role, you will take ownership of day-to-day financial operations and assist in driving growth within a fast-paced IT environment.
	The ideal candidate is an ICAN partly qualified professional who can confidently manage AR, AP, and GL processes while spearheading management account preparation.


Key Responsibilities
Financial Reporting & Management Accounts:


	Prepare monthly management accounts and variance analysis reports for leadership.
	Lead end-of-month closing processes to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.


Accounts Receivable (AR) & Accounts Payable (AP):


	Manage full-cycle Accounts Payable, verifying vendor invoices and processing payments.
	Oversee Accounts Receivable, managing client invoicing, collections, and aging schedules.


General Ledger (GL) Management:


	Maintain the General Ledger, posting journal entries and correcting adjustments.
	Perform regular bank reconciliations and balance sheet account reviews.


Process & Tech Optimization:


	Adopt new accounting software and adapt to automated financial tech tools.
	Maintain strict attention to detail to ensure compliance and eliminate data errors.


Requirements
Education & Professional Certifications:


	Professional qualification: ICAN partly qualified (Skills or Professional level required).
	Academic Degree: B.Sc. or HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.


Experience & Skills:


	Minimum 3 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in tech.
	Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Sage) and advancedMicrosoftExcel.
	Ability to learn quickly and thrive in a fast-growing IT industry.
	Exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and high integrity.


Salary
N300,000 (Net) per month.

Application Closing Date: 6th October, 2026.

Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Sales Executive (Enrol Web Services)

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	The Sales Executive is responsible for driving business growth by identifying new business opportunities, generating qualified leads, acquiring new customers, and managing customer relationships.
	The role owns the entire customer lifecyclefrom prospecting and sales through onboarding, account management, renewals, upselling, and cross-selling-to ensure long-term customer value and revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Prospecting:


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities through cold calling, telemarketing, emails, networking, referrals, events, and digital channels.
	Research target markets, organisations, and decision-makers.
	Generate and qualify leads.
	Build strategic relationships with prospective customers and partners.


Sales & Customer Acquisition:


	Conduct discovery meetings to understand customer needs.
	Present EnrolWeb's products and solutions.
	Prepare quotations, proposals, and commercial offers.
	Negotiate and close new business opportunities.
	Meet assigned revenue and customer acquisition targets.


Account Management:


	Serve as the primary relationship manager for assigned customer accounts.
	Build long-term relationships to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
	Manage renewals, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
	Conduct periodic customer reviews and identify opportunities for account growth.
	Ensure prompt follow-up on customer enquiries and requests.


Pipeline & CRM Management:


	Maintain an active pipeline of qualified opportunities.
	Update all customer interactions and opportunities in the CRM.
	Track prospects from lead through to closed business and ongoing account management.
	Ensure timely follow-up on all opportunities.


Collaboration:


	Work closely with Digital Marketing on lead generation campaigns.
	Coordinate with Service Delivery to ensure smooth customer onboarding and excellent service delivery.
	Work with Finance on quotations, invoicing, and payment follow-up where required.


Reporting:


	Submit weekly reports on:
	Prospecting activities
	Qualified leads generated
	Sales pipeline
	Revenue achieved
	New customers acquired
	Renewals and upsells
	Customer account status


Proposal & Solution Design Support:


	Prepare customer proposals, quotations, and solution presentations in line with customer requirements and company offerings.
	Work with Technical Support, Subscription Management, and Web Development teams to develop accurate scopes of work, implementation plans, and pricing.
	Conduct customer discovery sessions to identify business needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
	Present proposed solutions, value propositions, and project approaches to prospects and customers.
	Ensure all proposals are commercially viable, technically feasible, and aligned with company profitability objectives.
	Follow up on submitted proposals, address customer concerns, and coordinate revisions where necessary.
	Maintain proposal templates, pricing information, and supporting documentation to improve response times and proposal quality.


Requirements


	Candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc.) or Higher National Diploma (HND) with 3-4 years experience.


Required Skills:


	Strong business development and prospecting skills.
	Excellent communication and presentation skills.
	Relationship-building and customer management skills
	Negotiation and closing skills
	Commercial awareness and business acumen
	Ability to use CRM and sales tools effectively
	Good understanding of technology solutions, including cloud services, Microsoft 365, Zoho, web hosting, domains, website development, and cybersecurity
	Self-motivated, target-driven, and results-oriented
	Strong organisational and time management skills.


Application Closing Date: 23rd September, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Front Desk / Executive Assistant

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive, organized, and professional Front Desk / Executive Assistant to provide exceptional front desk services while offering administrative and executive support to the CEO and senior management team.
	The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, organizational, and multitasking skills, with a friendly and welcoming personality.


Key Responsibilities


	Welcome guests and visitors with a warm, professional, and friendly attitude.
	Schedule, coordinate, and confirm appointments, meetings, and reservations for executives.
	Provide accurate information about the company's products and services to clients.
	Maintain visitor logs, appointment schedules, and other administrative records.
	Provide administrative support to the CEO, executives, and senior managers.
	Handle multiple tasks simultaneously while effectively prioritizing responsibilities.
	Ensure the reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times.
	Prepare, organize, and maintain documents, reports, and presentations.
	Take minutes during meetings and provide executive briefings where necessary.
	Handle confidential and sensitive information with a high level of discretion.
	Coordinate company events, business functions, and conferences.
	Provide visitors with basic information and direct them to the appropriate departments.
	Perform general administrative duties as assigned.
	Support project management activities and follow up on assigned tasks to ensure timely completion.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc.) or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Business Administration, Office Administration, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Front Desk Officer, Executive Assistant, or in a similar administrative role.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Strong organizational and time management abilities.


Required Soft Skills:


	Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
	Professional appearance and positive attitude.
	Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
	High level of integrity and confidentiality.
	Attention to detail and accuracy.
	Problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Initiative and proactive approach to work.
	Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
	Adaptability and flexibility.


Salary & Benefits


	Net Salary: ?150,000 per month.


Benefits:


	Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) coverage.
	10% Employer Pension Contribution.
	Group Life Insurance.
	13th Month Salary.


Application Closing Date: 25th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

     

    

        Click here to Apply

E-Commerce Manager Job at Genesis Group




        
    

        
        Genesis Group is a wholly Nigerian-owned conglomerate established in 1991 by Ichie (Dr.) Nnaeto Orazulike, with its head office situated at Plot 198/199 Rumuogba Estate, Port Harcourt, Rivers State. Over more than three decades, the Group has grown into one of Nigeria's leading catering, hospitality, and entertainment conglomerates, with a footprint that spans hotels, restaurants, cinemas, shopping malls, property development, outdoor catering, industrial catering/camp management, and food production. Its interests also extend into real estate and technical support services within oil and gas.
     

            
    



With its roots in the restaurant industry, Genesis Foods is regarded as the foremost catering and hospitality organization east of the Niger, operating a wide network of quick-service and fine-dining restaurant brands across the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: E-Commerce Manager

Job Locations: Port Harcourt - Rivers, Delta, and Imo
Employment Type: Full-time

Core Responsibilities


	Website Optimization:Maintain the online platform, ensuring a user-friendly, on-brand, and secure experience.
	Digital Marketing & Sales:Develop and execute campaigns (email, PPC, SEO, social media) to increase traffic and revenue.
	Merchandising & Inventory:Manage product listings, pricing, and promotions to maximize sales,
	Analytics & Reporting:Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) like traffic, conversion rates, and ROI to inform strategic decisions,
	Technical & Operational Support:Manage inventory and collaborate with logistics for smooth fulfillment, as detailed by Myskillsfuture.gov.sg.


Performance Metrics (KPIs)


	Conversion Rate
	Average Order Value (AOV)
	Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
	Return on Investment (ROI) of marketing campaigns
	Website Traffic and Traffic-to-lead Ratio.


Required Skills and Qualifications


	Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, E-Commerce, or IT.
	Experience: 3 - 5 years in e-commerce, digital marketing, or a similar role.
	Platform Knowledge: Proficiency in platforms like Shopify, Magento, or WooCommerce.
	Technical Skills: Expertise in Google Analytics, SEO/SEM, and CRM tools,
	Soft Skills: Strong analytical skills, strategic mindset, and excellent communication skills.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using Job Position as the subject of the mail
